shortDescription: Corus (0x807...aca1) bought a total of 7.14 million EDEL for $200,000, according to Lookonchain monitoring. According to Odaily, the trader made $34.95 million on Hyperliquid and still holds 137,100 HYPE worth $12.27 million. EDEL has risen 750% over the past two months.
